title: My weekend
instructions: Jack hafta sonunu anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; cumartesi ve pazar günlerini karıştırma.

script.speaker: jack
script.text: Hi, I'm Jack. I love weekends!

script.speaker: jack
script.text: On Saturday morning, I get up late, at ten o'clock.

script.speaker: jack
script.text: I have a big breakfast with eggs and toast.

script.speaker: jack
script.text: Then I play football in the park with my friends.

script.speaker: jack
script.text: In the afternoon, I go shopping with my mum.

script.speaker: jack
script.text: We buy food for the week.

script.speaker: jack
script.text: On Saturday evening, my family and I watch a film at home.

script.speaker: jack
script.text: On Sunday, we visit my grandparents.

script.speaker: jack
script.text: They live in a village near the mountains.

script.speaker: jack
script.text: My grandmother makes a big lunch for us.

script.speaker: jack
script.text: After lunch, I walk in the forest with my grandfather.

script.speaker: jack
script.text: We come home at six o'clock in the evening.

script.speaker: jack
script.text: I'm always tired on Sunday night!

questions.prompt: What time does Jack get up on Saturday?
questions.feedback: Cumartesi geç, saat onda (ten o'clock) kalkıyor. "Six" pazar akşamı eve dönüş saati.
questions.evidence: I get up late, at ten o'clock.

questions.prompt: Who does Jack go shopping with?
questions.feedback: Alışverişe annesiyle (mum) gidiyor. Arkadaşlarıyla futbol oynuyor, dedesiyle yürüyüş yapıyor.
questions.evidence: I go shopping with my mum.

options: in a village near the mountains
questions.feedback: Büyükanne ve büyükbabası dağların yakınındaki bir köyde (village) yaşıyor.
questions.evidence: They live in a village near the mountains.
